file_stem: RWB TE 001 Recovery module folder and boundary test
title: Recovery module folder and boundary test
goal: Module packages plus a build-time ArchUnit test, so no module reaches another's internals
why: 19 modules stay separable. The build fails the moment a class imports another module's internals; E1-069 adds BND-6 so nobody reads public.* tables.
ace_note: No ACE read. This story sets the rules; RWB-E1-069 adds BND-6 'read recovery.v_ace_*, never public.*' to this same test.
stores: architecture/recovery-modules.yaml (module map); front-end src/modules/recovery; CI pipeline

functions.name: RecoveryAccessGuard
functions.does: common access check for the API

rules: BND-1: the collection module only through its published packages
BND-3: recovery modules meet only through published packages or events
BND-4: a module uses only its own entities and repositories
BND-5: HTTP, SFTP and file clients only in recovery.integration.adapter
risks: Import of a collection internal class -> build fails (BND-1)
Using another module's entity -> build fails (BND-4)
